checkedAlternates.resolution: /f/ and /v/ contact the upper teeth with the lower lip, making them labiodental (group-2) rather than bilabial (group-3).
/m/ closes both lips (bilabial, group-3), whereas /n/ uses the tongue tip at the alveolar ridge (group-4).
